使用指令隱藏和自訂其他玩家的名稱 ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/802/421/2024-02-04-15-55-25-1.gif) 指令
指令 ``` /hiddennames nameplateVisible [player(s)] [true/false] /hiddennames defaultVisible [true/false] /hiddennames blocksHideName [true/false] Blocks in the way hide the nameplate /hiddennames setName [player(s)] [colour] [animation] ["name"] The name argument has to be in quotes /hiddennames setName [player(s)] name ["name"] /hiddennames setName [player(s)] colour [colour] /hiddennames setName [player(s)] animation [animation] /hiddennames setName [player(s)] reset ``` All commands require op level 2 or more to execute.
